verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms MailerLite has its own automations feature: they can be managed from the CLI and abandoned-cart automations can be triggered via API. It says nothing about a multi-step builder or the branching, delay, and exit-rule mechanics the story requires. missing for 10: documented multi-step workflow builder, conditional branches/splits, delay steps, exit/goal rules, welcome/onboarding/winback templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build multi-step lifecycle automations — welcome series, onboarding, winback — with branches, delays, and exit rules

citations.quote: manage subscribers, campaigns, automations, and more from your terminal
